description: Configurable payment router. Per deployment, defines which payment DocType the Pay action creates and how Salis Payment Request fields map onto it. Replaces the inert Habitat Settings default_payment_method with a real mapping-driven router. Routes the payment record only; GL posting stays governed by enable_gl_posting.

fields.default:
Payment Router

This single record is the configurable, mapping-driven payment-integration layer. When the Create Payment action runs on a finance-approved Salis Payment Request, the router reads this config, builds the target payment document by applying the field map below, and (optionally) submits it — with no hard-coded per-DocType branches. Set it once per deployment.

It replaces the now-inert default_payment_method on Apex Settings: instead of a fixed Select, the target payment DocType is a real Link → DocType and the source→target field mapping lives in config, so different companies/servers (ERPNext Payment Entry, Payment Order, or a client's own custom payment DocType) are supported without changing code. Left blank, the router builds the native Payment Request — Frappe's standard payment-intent document — so the flow works with no configuration.

This layer only routes the payment record. General Ledger posting is governed separately by enable_gl_posting on Apex Settings; the router writes no GL and, while that flag is off, leaves the routed payment in Draft so nothing posts.
fields.label: About

fields.description: The payment DocType the Create Payment action builds (for example Payment Entry, Payment Order, or a client's custom payment DocType). Leave blank to use the native Payment Request, the default target. A Single settings record or a child table is refused: neither can be created as a standalone payment.
fields.label: Target Payment DocType

fields.description: When checked and the target DocType is submittable, the router submits the created payment document. Default off (leave the payment in Draft for review).
fields.label: Auto-submit Target Payment

fields.default: Each row sets one field on the target payment document. For a normal mapping, give the Target Fieldname (on the target DocType) and the Source Fieldname to copy from the Salis Payment Request (for example amount, supplier, company, cost_center, project, remarks). Check Static to write a constant Static Value instead (for example a fixed payment_type or party_type).
